notes.title: Aralunis is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2][b]Aralunis is now available! 🎉[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="qx9RY_g_HNs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A princess sets out on a journey to save the hero who was mistakenly captured 👑✨
By her side, an untrustworthy guide — obsessed with mushrooms 🍄 and hiding secrets far deeper than they seem... 👀[/p][p]What starts as a cute and innocent fairy tale quickly strays from the script 📖❌
